problem: In merge, `plc = lc` inside the `hi > phi` branch overwrites a closed lower bound with the open flag of a later same-lower-bound interval (e.g. [1,2] merged with (1,3) yields (1,3) and loses point 1), breaking normalize, union, intersection and difference.
No regression test covers the same-lower-bound, mixed-closedness merge case in either input order.
Pre-existing: NaN bounds pass parse (is_number accepts NaN) and corrupt sorting and merging instead of raising ValueError.
